verdict.rationale: Kimi's help-center index lists a first-party PPT assistant with template selection and smart layout. It also lists an Agent that builds webpages and supports multi-round revision, so the product itself offers file and presentation creation with iterative edits. The evidence is only one-line help-index headings, though. Kimi Code's file editing concerns code projects rather than knowledge-worker documents. Missing for 10: documented document/word-file creation, explicit export or download of presentations and files, documented iterative editing of presentations specifically, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
